narr: Monsoon thunderstorms occurred on September 28 and 29, mainly impacting the mountains of San Bernardino, Riverside and San Diego Counties. Several reports of local flash flooding, heavy rain and small hail were received.
ev: Law enforcement reported roadway flooding on I-10 along the Riverside/San Bernardino County line. County and Bryant Road intersection closed due to flooding, with several inches of water over the roadway. Social media reports of flood damage to inside of garages and backside of two homes in the area. CWOP site in Yucaipa reported 0.84 inch of rain in 25 minutes.
